provenance.cache: fresh process/store per run; OS page cache retained; same-process owner reopen
provenance.scope: batch-only compact baseline versus packed metadata, production frame codec, and native SST/index compression; default WAL settings; same post-consumption collection
limits: PoC history is append-only saved-cut filtering, not native retained table history
forced maintenance, not sustained natural compaction or power-loss recovery
CPU and RSS include all scans, points, replay, and integrity checks

verification.matrix_stdout_log: not retained; all per-run reports and process logs retained

recommendations: Keep batch payloads and the existing production RawCommit codec. Do not introduce the PoC MessagePack batch format into production.
Do not make a production metadata format change for these small, mixed timing gains. The packed metadata experiment saves only12KiB after collection at the large size.
Use native keyspace compression as a space option at the first post-maintenance boundary. Do not claim a throughput improvement or the same saving after collection.
Use real keyspaces for table boundaries. Keep source and first cursor as the logical event key. Do not narrow numeric IDs or add another catalogue only to save batch key bytes.
Keep original journals until durable consumer progress permits collection. Measure retained payload space separately from journal and table lifecycle allocation.

statistic_definitions.intake_rate: median of four per-run event counts divided by summed acceptance time
statistic_definitions.cycle_rate: median of four complete timed loops including intake, capture, input read and durable result/reference/progress
statistic_definitions.latency_quantiles: pooled equal-size batches, sorted indexes n/2,n*95/100,n*99/100
statistic_definitions.initial_space: allocated blocks after forced maintenance at N events before first reopen
statistic_definitions.post_gc_space: allocated blocks after safe collection at the same N+512 events
statistic_definitions.journal_logical_counts: decoded original journal item counts,key bytes,value bytes; not compressed or physical device writes
statistic_definitions.read_rate: median of four complete scan rates including exact bytes and positions
statistic_definitions.point_latency: lookup/decode/construction, before exact-output verification, after complete scans
statistic_definitions.resources: whole process including all untimed reads, integrity checks, maintenance, reopen and GC
